note: The ash country's vents and ground (world/cinder_country.gd, triage 60): two views of the vent country by day and at night. The near one stands 24 m from two vents in a hollow south of Greyfold; the wide one looks across the heath by the Ninth Waystone at two more. Run with --no-cinder-country for the same views without it (the perf 'before').
